items.title: Joe Temperley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: I mean I think of myself, I have maybe about 60 or 70 Duke Ellington CDs. In those days, the only Duke Ellington song I probably knew would be maybe “Take the A Train” or something.

ctx.x: Right, yes. I mean I think of myself, I have maybe about 60 or 70 Duke Ellington CDs. In those days, the only Duke Ellington song I probably knew would be maybe “Take the A Train” or something.
Interesting that you ended up playing with them. But we’ll get to that. You played with Humphrey Lyttelton? Was he one of the well known jazz people in the United Kingdom?
